name: Container Diagram — Backend Architecture
description: C4 Container Diagram (Level 2) describes the technology containers in the system: Web Application, API Application, Database and Message Queue. Each container is a separately deployable unit.
purpose: Describe the backend architecture at the container level: technology, responsibilities and communication between containers.
bestFor: Describing technologies used (React, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Kafka)
Identifying how services communicate with each other
Architecture documentation for the development team
useCases: Identify containers: Single-Page App, API Application, Database, Message Queue
Assign technologies: React, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Kafka
Draw relationships: SPA calls API via REST/HTTPS
Add External: Payment Gateway, Email Service
requirements: REQ-001: SPA (React) runs on browser, calls API via HTTPS
REQ-002: API Application (Spring Boot) handles business logic
REQ-004: Message Queue (Kafka) handles async events
